# Bitcoin Roatán

> A neutral, practical guide to using Bitcoin on Roatán, Honduras: where to spend it, where to get it, and who to ask. English and Spanish. No hype, just facts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bitcoinroatan.info/): Landing page with a curated list of Bitcoin projects on the island.
- [Hub](https://bitcoinroatan.info/hub): Entry point to all guide sections.
- [Why Bitcoin](https://bitcoinroatan.info/why): Why Bitcoin matters on Roatán.
- [Use Bitcoin](https://bitcoinroatan.info/use): Merchant map, Bitcoin ATMs, wallets and a getting-started checklist.
- [What's Up](https://bitcoinroatan.info/whatsup): Bitcoin events, meetups and community links.
- [About](https://bitcoinroatan.info/about): The project and its partners.

## Data and code

- Merchant data comes from BTCMap (https://btcmap.org/map), a community map built on OpenStreetMap.
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/itstomekk/bitcoin-roatan
